official_measurement_examples: PiP is a two-stage consent route with TDC as the detailed second stage
PiP scope is location land use and amount of development
development cannot proceed on PiP alone without TDC
TDC grant has the effect of granting planning permission
PiP application statutory decision period is 5 weeks unless extended by agreement
TDC periods are 10 weeks for major and 5 weeks for other development with EIA context separate
Jan-Mar 2026 LPAs reported 429 PiP decisions and 36 TDC decisions
PiP or TDC does not establish ownership access rights or final development yield
core_rules: PiP alone is not full planning permission
TDC must match the specified PiP
PiP scope is limited to location use and amount
PiP cannot silently substitute for TDC
TDC does not replace other statutory consents
PiP grant does not establish ownership
PiP grant does not establish access rights
brownfield register presence is not automatic PiP unless statutory Part 2 requirements are met
application PiP and register-triggered PiP remain distinct routes
conditions attach at TDC not PiP stage
planning obligations are not secured at PiP stage
EIA and habitats requirements remain separate
determination period can be extended by written agreement
no parcel PiP clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
